description: FREE headline pre-check (100/day per wallet; pass caller). Returns assessability only - whether the log is in the published contract form; no counts are computed. The full signed analysis is the paid lifecycle_analyse call.

as_of.description: The evaluation timestamp (ISO 8601) the counts are computed as of.

caller.description: Solana base58 wallet of the operator; keys the free allowance (100/day per wallet).

log.description: The challenge-issuance log to analyse: entries with challenge_id, issued_at, expires_at, optional used_at and rail, in the published log contract form. Processed in memory only, never stored.

name: lifecycle_precheck
